query: SELECT ss.id, ss.programId, p.name, p.type, ss.slotDate, ss.startTime, ss.endTime FROM schedule_slots ss JOIN programs p ON ss.programId = p.id ORDER BY ss.slotDate DESC LIMIT 20;
